        "contents": "export const MindMapBottomMenu = () =\u003e {\n...\nexport const MindMapBottomMenu = () =\u003e {\n...\nexport const MindMapBottomMenu = () =\u003e {\n  ...\n  const handleLoadingRecords = useCallback(\n  ...\n  const handleLoadingRecords = useCallback(\n    ...\n    async ({data: {type}}: {data: {type: string}}) =\u003e {\n      console.log('🚀 ~ MindMapBottomMenu ~ type:', type)\n\n\n        ...\n\n\n        // Filter out any nodes that already exist in the graph\n        if (flowData.nodes \u0026\u0026 flowData.nodes.length \u003e 0) {\n          const filteredNodes = flowData.nodes.filter((node) =\u003e !nodeExists(node.id, node.type))\n\n          if (filteredNodes.length \u003e 0) {\n            addNodes(filteredNodes)\n            addEdges(flowData.edges)\n\n            // Update the user input node with the AI analysis\n            if (flowData.xataResponse?.records) {\n              updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n                entities: flowData.xataResponse.records,\n                answer: flowData.xataResponse.answer,\n                sessionId: flowData.xataResponse.sessionId,\n              })\n            }\n          } else {\n            // No new nodes to add\n            updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n              input: &#96;No new ${type} data found. All relevant records are already on the graph.&#96;,\n            })\n          }\n        } else if (flowData.xataResponse?.records?.length === 0) {\n          // No data found\n          updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n            input: &#96;No ${type} data found.&#96;,\n          })\n        } else {\n          // Error occurred\n          updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n            input: &#96;Error loading ${type} data.&#96;,\n          })\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error loading data for mind map:', error)\n        // Update user node to show error\n        updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n          input: &#96;Error loading ${type} data: ${\n            error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n          }&#96;,\n        })\n      }\n    },\n    [\n      screenToFlowPosition,\n      calculateCenterOfScreen,\n      getNextId,\n      addNode,\n      addNodes,\n      addEdges,\n      updateNodeData,\n      getNodes,\n      nodeExists,\n    ]\n  )",

All relevant records are already on the graph.&#96;,\n            })\n          }\n        } else if (flowData.xataResponse?.records?.length === 0) {\n          // No data found\n          updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n            input: &#96;No ${type} data found.&#96;,\n          })\n        } else {\n          // Error occurred\n          updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n            input: &#96;Error loading ${type} data.&#96;,\n          })\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error loading data for mind map:', error)\n        // Update user node to show error\n        updateNodeData(potentialUserNode.id, {\n          input: &#96;Error loading ${type} data: ${\n            error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n          }&#96;,\n        })\n      }\n    },\n    [\n      screenToFlowPosition,\n      calculateCenterOfScreen,\n      getNextId,\n      addNode,\n      addNodes,\n      addEdges,\n      updateNodeData,\n      getNodes,\n      nodeExists,\n    ]\n  )",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Custom key down handler to intercept the \"/\" key\n  const handleLocalKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    // If the key is \"/\" and the input is empty or not already starting with \"/\"\n    if (e.key === '/' \u0026\u0026 (inputValue === '' || !inputValue.startsWith('/'))) {\n      // If the cursor is at the start of the input, open command options\n      if ((e.target as HTMLInputElement).selectionStart === 0) {\n        setIsOpen(true)\n        setFilteredOptions(commandOptions)\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Pass the event to the original handler\n    handleKeyDown(e)\n  }\n\n  // Update button text for proper button aria-label based on context\n  const getButtonAriaLabel = () =\u003e {\n    if (activeCommand === 'chat' || activeCommand === 'deepresearch') {\n      return 'Send message'\n    }\n    if (activeCommand === 'search') {\n      return 'Search database'\n    }\n    if (activeModel) {\n      return &#96;Add ${activeModel} to mindmap&#96;\n    }\n    return 'Oracle options'\n  }\n\n  // Auto-scroll to the latest message whenever messages change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (messagesContainerRef.current \u0026\u0026 messages \u0026\u0026 messages.length \u003e 0) {\n      messagesContainerRef.current.scrollTop = messagesContainerRef.current.scrollHeight\n    }\n  }, [messages])\n\n  // Reset filtered options when isOpen changes to false\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!isOpen) {\n      setFilteredOptions(commandOptions)\n    }\n  }, [isOpen, commandOptions])",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport const OracleCommandList = ({\n  isOpen,\n  activeCommand,\n  filteredCommands,\n  handleCommandSelect,\n}: OracleCommandListProps) =\u003e {\n  return (\n    \u003cAnimatePresence\u003e\n      {isOpen \u0026\u0026 !activeCommand \u0026\u0026 (\n        \u003cmotion.div\n          initial={{opacity: 0, y: 8}}\n          animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}\n          exit={{opacity: 0, y: 8}}\n          transition={{duration: 0.15}}\n          className='absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-auto z-40 flex justify-center items-center'\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className='rounded-lg shadow-lg w-[444px] h-[400px] mt-2 rounded-lg border border-neutral-700/30 text-neutral-500 bg-black bg-gradient-to-b from-black relative rounded-tl-lg rounded-tr-lg '\u003e\n            \u003cCommand className='w-full'\u003e\n              \u003cCommand.List className=''\u003e\n                {filteredCommands.map((command) =\u003e (\n                  \u003cCommandListItem\n                    key={command.id}\n                    command={command}\n                    onSelect={handleCommandSelect}\n                  /\u003e\n                ))}\n              \u003c/Command.List\u003e\n            \u003c/Command\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/motion.div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/AnimatePresence\u003e\n  )\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst OracleCore = ({color = '#1E88E5', size = 1}) =\u003e {\n  const groupRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Group\u003e(null)\n\n  // Define the concentric spheres with different opacities\n  // to match the OracleIcon's radiating paths\n  const layers = [\n    {radius: size * 1.0, opacity: 0.5},\n    {radius: size * 0.95, opacity: 0.45},\n    {radius: size * 0.9, opacity: 0.4},\n    {radius: size * 0.85, opacity: 0.35},\n    {radius: size * 0.8, opacity: 0.3},\n    {radius: size * 0.75, opacity: 0.25},\n    {radius: size * 0.7, opacity: 0.2},\n    {radius: size * 0.65, opacity: 0.15},\n    {radius: size * 0.6, opacity: 0.1},\n    {radius: size * 0.55, opacity: 0.05},\n  ]\n\n  // Animate the sphere rotation\n  useFrame((state, delta) =\u003e {\n    if (groupRef.current) {\n      groupRef.current.rotation.y += delta * 0.1\n    }\n  })\n\n  return (\n    \u003cgroup ref={groupRef}\u003e\n      {/* Outer shell - base sphere */}\n      \u003cSphere args={[size, 64, 64]}\u003e\n        \u003cmeshStandardMaterial color={color} transparent opacity={0.8} /\u003e\n      \u003c/Sphere\u003e\n\n      {/* Create concentric spheres with decreasing opacity */}\n      {layers.map((layer, i) =\u003e (\n        \u003cSphere key={&#96;layer-${i}-${layer.opacity}&#96;} args={[layer.radius, 48, 48]}\u003e\n          \u003cmeshStandardMaterial\n            color={color}\n            transparent\n            opacity={layer.opacity}\n            side={THREE.BackSide}\n          /\u003e\n        \u003c/Sphere\u003e\n      ))}\n    \u003c/group\u003e\n  )\n}",

The issue is now fixed. I've updated the `handleChange` function in the MindMapBottomMenu component to safely handle different types of inputs:

1. If `e` is a string, it directly sets the input value
2. If `e` is an event object with a valid target and value, it sets the input value from e.target.value
3. If neither condition is met, it logs a warning

This ensures the function can handle both regular change events and direct string values, preventing the "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value')" error.

The updated code will properly handle the input value setting in all cases, making your mindmap-bottom-menu component more robust.

        "originalContents": "\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (activeItem.current \u0026\u0026 scrollContainer.current) {\n      const offsetTop = activeItem.current.offsetTop\n      const offsetHeight = activeItem.current.offsetHeight\n\n      scrollContainer.current.scrollTop = offsetTop - offsetHeight\n    }\n  }, [selectedCommandIndex, selectedGroupIndex])\n\n  const createCommandClickHandler = useCallback(\n    (groupIndex: number, commandIndex: number) =\u003e {\n      return () =\u003e {\n        selectItem(groupIndex, commandIndex)\n      }\n    },\n    [selectItem],\n  )\n\n  if (!props.items.length) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cSurface ref={scrollContainer} className=\"text-black max-h-[min(80vh,24rem)] overflow-auto flex-wrap mb-8 p-2\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 gap-0.5\"\u003e\n        {props.items.map((group, groupIndex: number) =\u003e (\n          \u003cReact.Fragment key={&#96;${group.title}-wrapper&#96;}\u003e\n            \u003cdiv\n              className=\"text-neutral-500 text-[0.65rem] col-[1/-1] mx-2 mt-4 font-semibold tracking-wider select-none uppercase first:mt-0.5\"\n              key={&#96;${group.title}&#96;}\n            \u003e\n              {group.title}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            {group.commands.map((command: Command, commandIndex: number) =\u003e (\n              \u003cDropdownButton\n                key={&#96;${command.label}&#96;}\n                isActive={selectedGroupIndex === groupIndex \u0026\u0026 selectedCommandIndex === commandIndex}\n                onClick={createCommandClickHandler(groupIndex, commandIndex)}\n              \u003e\n                \u003cIcon name={command.iconName} className=\"mr-1\" /\u003e\n                {command.label}\n              \u003c/DropdownButton\u003e\n            ))}\n          \u003c/React.Fragment\u003e\n        ))}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/Surface\u003e\n  )\n})",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const OracleCommandList = ({\n  isOpen,\n  activeCommand,\n  commands,\n  handleCommandSelect,\n  inputValue = '',\n  setInputValue,\n  handleKeyDown,\n}: OracleCommandListProps) =\u003e {\n  // Internal state for filtered commands\n  const [filteredCommands, setFilteredCommands] = useState\u003cReadonlyArray\u003cCommandItem\u003e\u003e(commands)\n\n  // Filter commands based on input value\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (inputValue.startsWith('/')) {\n      const searchTerm = inputValue.slice(1).toLowerCase()\n      const filtered = commands.filter(\n        (command) =\u003e\n          (command.name?.toLowerCase() || '').includes(searchTerm) ||\n          (command.label?.toLowerCase() || '').includes(searchTerm) ||\n          command.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||\n          (command.prefix?.toLowerCase() || '').includes(searchTerm)\n      )\n      setFilteredCommands(filtered)\n    } else {\n      setFilteredCommands(commands)\n    }\n  }, [inputValue, commands])\n\n  // Function to handle command selection\n  const handleItemSelect = (command: CommandItem) =\u003e {\n    // Clear input when selecting a command\n    if (setInputValue) {\n      setInputValue('')\n    }\n\n    // Use the original ID format if possible for display purposes\n    // This ensures commands like \"Search\" retain their capitalization instead of \"search\"\n    const displayId = command.label || command.name || command.id\n\n    // Call the parent handler with the proper ID\n    handleCommandSelect(displayId)\n  }\n\n  // Determine if we should show the input-specific style\n  const useInputStyle = Boolean(inputValue \u0026\u0026 inputValue.startsWith('/'))\n\n  // Skip rendering if not open or if a command is already active\n  if (!isOpen || activeCommand) {\n    return null\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n      try {\n        // Choose layout type based on content type\n        let layoutType: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'radial' | 'grid' = 'horizontal'\n\n        // Customize layout based on entity type for optimal visualization\n        switch (type) {\n          case 'events':\n            layoutType = 'horizontal'\n            break\n          case 'personnel':\n          case 'organizations':\n            layoutType = 'radial'\n            break\n          case 'testimonies':\n            layoutType = 'vertical'\n            break\n          case 'documents':\n          case 'artifacts':\n            layoutType = 'grid'\n            break\n          default:\n            layoutType = 'horizontal'\n        }\n\n        const flowData = await xataToXYFlow({\n          question: query,\n          table: type,\n          rules: &#96;Find the most interesting ${type} records that have clear relationships between them&#96;,\n          context: &#96;The user is exploring records in the ${type} database&#96;,\n          existingNodes,\n          sourceNode: potentialUserNode,\n          layoutType, // Pass the selected layout type\n        })",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport function MindMapUtilityCursor( {\n  targetElement,\n  additionalTargets,\n}: any ) {\n  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState( false )\n  const targetRef: any = useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null )\n  const refs = [targetRef, ...additionalTargets].map( useRef )\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState( false )\n\n\n\n  const handlePositionChange = ( x: number, y: number ) =\u003e {\n    if ( targetRef.current ) {\n      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()\n      const isInside =\n        x \u003e= rect.left \u0026\u0026 x \u003c= rect.right \u0026\u0026 y \u003e= rect.top \u0026\u0026 y \u003c= rect.bottom\n      setIsHovering( isInside )\n    }\n  }\n\n  useEffect( () =\u003e {\n    if ( targetElement ) {\n      targetRef.current = targetElement\n    } else {\n      const graph = document.querySelector( '.react-flow__nodes' )\n      targetRef.current = graph\n    }\n  }, [targetElement] )\n\n  useEffect( () =\u003e {\n    if ( targetRef.current ) {\n      targetRef.current.addEventListener( 'click', () =\u003e {\n        setMenuOpen( true )\n      } )\n\n    }\n  }, [targetElement] )",

just toggle command menu visibility\n  const handleInputFocus = () =\u003e {\n    if (inputValue.startsWith('/')) {\n      setIsOpen(true)\n    }\n  }\n\n  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const value = e.target.value\n    setInputValue(value)\n\n    // Toggle command visibility based on input\n    if (value.startsWith('/')) {\n      setIsOpen(true)\n    } else if (isOpen \u0026\u0026 !activeCommand) {\n      setIsOpen(false)\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Handle the '/' key specially\n  const handleLocalKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    if (e.key === '/' \u0026\u0026 inputValue === '') {\n      setIsOpen(true)\n    }\n    handleKeyDown(e)\n  }\n\n  // Auto-scroll to the latest message whenever messages change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (messagesContainerRef.current \u0026\u0026 messages \u0026\u0026 messages.length \u003e 0) {\n      messagesContainerRef.current.scrollTop = messagesContainerRef.current.scrollHeight\n    }\n  }, [messages])\n\n  // Get the appropriate button aria-label\n  const getButtonAriaLabel = () =\u003e {\n    if (activeCommand === 'chat' || activeCommand === 'deepresearch') {\n      return 'Send message'\n    }\n    if (activeCommand === 'search') {\n      return 'Search database'\n    }\n    if (activeModel) {\n      return &#96;Add ${activeModel} to mindmap&#96;\n    }\n    return 'Oracle options'\n  }",
